title: Halo: Campaign Evolved Reviews Land Strong but Mark a Series Low
excerpt: The Unreal Engine 5 remake of the 2001 classic earns an 82 on Metacritic ahead of its July 28 launch — broadly positive, but the lowest score for any mainline Halo entry.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Halo: Campaign Evolved scores 82 on Metacritic, the lowest for any mainline Halo game.
  • The remake is built on Unreal Engine 5 and launches on PlayStation for the first time.
  • Critics praised its faithful recreation but questioned the safety of its approach to reviving the franchise.
  • New features include 4-player co-op and prequel missions, but it lacks player-versus-player multiplayer.

Strong Reviews, but a Franchise in Transition

Reviews for Halo: Campaign Evolved landed on Wednesday ahead of the game's July 28 launch, and the consensus is broadly favorable — with a caveat. The Unreal Engine 5 remake of the 2001 classic that defined a generation of console shooters earned a Metacritic score of 82 and an OpenCritic average of 84, placing it firmly in "good" territory but below every mainline Halo entry in the franchise's 25-year history.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=5KhzCSeZxAU

The original Halo: Combat Evolved holds a 97 on Metacritic, one of the highest ratings ever recorded. Halo 2 scored 95. Halo 3 hit 94. Even the divisive Halo 5: Guardians managed 84. At 82, Campaign Evolved sits alongside Halo 3: ODST — a game that was originally positioned as an expansion, not a full release.

What Critics Are Saying

VGC gave the remake a perfect score, calling it "irresistible" for returning fans. "For younger players who didn't get the chance to experience one of the best shooter campaigns ever, it feels even more essential," the review said.

"What Critics Are Saying VGC gave the remake a perfect score, calling it "irresistible" for returning fans."

Game Informer awarded an 85, writing that "Campaign Evolved is a superb update and rebuild of what made the original great, but it stops short of a complete restructuring of that landmark game. Even constrained by some of the features that defined the 2001 classic, this new version nails the roiling current of chaos that made it so fun all those years ago."

TheGamer's Jade King called it "a faithful revival that understands what made the artistic direction of Bungie's ambitious sci-fi world so special in the first place" in a 4-out-of-5 review.

GamesRadar+ struck a more cautious note, giving it a 7 out of 10. "The promise of an evolved campaign experience, like Installation 04 itself, rings hollow, and I'm left wondering if playing it safe is really what Xbox should be aiming for with Halo right now," the review said.

A New Engine and a New Platform

Campaign Evolved represents several firsts for the franchise. It is the first Halo game built on Unreal Engine 5, following Halo Studios' pivot away from the Slipspace Engine and the studio's 2024 rebrand from 343 Industries. It is also the first Halo title available on PlayStation 5, ending a quarter-century of Xbox exclusivity for the franchise's single-player campaign.

The remake includes 4-player cooperative multiplayer — a feature absent from the 2001 original — along with mechanical updates such as sprinting and the ability to hijack Covenant vehicles. Three new prequel missions featuring Master Chief and Sergeant Johnson have been added, set a year before the events of the original game.

The Jiralhanae (Brutes), enemies who originally debuted in Halo 2, now appear from the start, as does the Flood's infection form from Halo 3. Notably absent is player-versus-player multiplayer, reportedly cancelled during internal upheaval at the studio.

Can Halo Recapture Its Cultural Moment?

The stakes extend beyond review scores. Halo's cultural relevance has waned steadily since Bungie released Halo: Reach in 2010, and Halo Studios is betting that returning to the franchise's roots can rebuild momentum. Campaign Evolved functions as both a nostalgia play for longtime fans and an introduction for a generation of gamers who never experienced the original.

Key Features of Campaign Evolved
›First Halo game on PlayStation 5
›Built on Unreal Engine 5
›Includes 4-player cooperative multiplayer
›Adds three new prequel missions
›No player-versus-player multiplayer

For India's growing gaming community — the country's gaming market now exceeds $3 billion — the PlayStation debut opens the franchise to a platform that dominates the Indian console market. Whether that translates into meaningful engagement will depend on whether the remake can compete for attention in a crowded summer release window.

Halo: Campaign Evolved launches July 28 for Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, and PC, with full cross-platform play support.
